description: High-availability control plane. HQ runs a normal cluster with a primary; DR runs a standby cluster whose leader replicates from HQ.

panels.title: Primaries
panels.description: Exactly one primary is expected in HQ. Two means split brain; zero means writes are unavailable.

panels.title: Standby Leaders
panels.description: The DR cluster leader, which replicates from HQ and feeds the other DR nodes.

panels.title: Clusters Unlocked
panels.description: Unlocked means no node holds the leader lock in etcd — an election is in progress or has failed.

panels.title: Auto-Failover Paused
panels.description: Patroni is in maintenance mode and will not fail over.

targets.expr: sum(patroni_is_paused{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pending Restart
panels.description: A configuration change needs a PostgreSQL restart to take effect — for example archive_mode.

panels.title: Failsafe Mode Active
panels.description: Patroni lost contact with etcd and is holding the primary up via direct node-to-node checks.

panels.title: Role Timeline
panels.description: Every role change and failover in the selected window. Blue = primary, purple = standby leader, green = replica.

targets.expr: patroni_primary{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"} * 3 + patroni_standby_leader{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"} * 2 + patroni_replica{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"}

patroni_primary{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"} * 3 + patroni_standby_leader{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"} * 2 + patroni_replica{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"}

panels.title: Time Since DCS (etcd) Last Seen
panels.description: How long ago each node last talked to etcd successfully. Growing values mean Patroni is about to demote itself.

panels.title: Replication Lag (bytes)
panels.description: Highest LSN known in the cluster minus each replica's replayed LSN. Works for both HQ (leader publishes xlog_location) and DR (standby leader publishes received_location).

targets.expr: max by (site, scope) ({__name__=~"patroni_xlog_location|patroni_xlog_received_location", job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope"}) - on (site, scope) group_right () (patroni_xlog_replayed_location{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"} != 0)

panels.title: Replay Delay (seconds)
panels.description: Wall-clock age of the last replayed transaction. This is the number that matters for the DR RPO.

panels.title: Receive → Replay Gap (bytes)
panels.description: WAL that arrived but has not been applied yet. A large gap with a small network lag means replay is CPU or I/O bound.

targets.expr: (patroni_xlog_received_location{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"} != 0) - patroni_xlog_replayed_location{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"}

panels.title: Streaming Replication Active
panels.description: A replica that stops streaming falls back to archive recovery, which is much slower.

panels.title: WAL Generation Rate (leader)
panels.description: How fast the primary produces WAL. Drives archiving volume and the DR bandwidth requirement.

panels.title: WAL Replay Rate (replicas)
panels.description: If replay rate stays below the generation rate, lag grows without bound.

panels.title: Sync / Quorum Standby
panels.description: Only meaningful when synchronous_mode is enabled.

panels.title: PostgreSQL Timeline
panels.description: The timeline increases on every promotion. Nodes on different timelines cannot replicate from each other.

panels.title: Timeline Divergence per Cluster
panels.description: Non-zero means at least one node is stuck on an older timeline and needs a pg_rewind or reinit.

targets.expr: max by (site, scope) (patroni_postgres_timeline{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"}) - min by (site, scope) (patroni_postgres_timeline{job=~"patroni_.*", site=~"$site", scope=~"$scope", name=~"$name"})

panels.title: PostgreSQL Uptime
panels.description: Resets on every restart or failover.

panels.title: Postgres State
panels.description: Numeric representation of the state Patroni reports for PostgreSQL on this node.

panels.title: Patroni REST API Up
panels.description: HAProxy uses this same endpoint for its health checks — if it is down here, HAProxy is also removing the node from its backends.

title: Patroni — HQ & DR
